steps.en: The decision to charge in court is recorded and endorsed by the 2OIC
steps.id: Keputusan charge di pengadilan dicatat dan di-endorse oleh 2OIC
steps.why_en: The screens exist but are hidden from the menu, and the part that stores the decision is not in the code.
steps.why_id: Layar ada tetapi disembunyikan dari menu, dan bagian yang menyimpan keputusan tidak ada di code.

steps.en: After endorsement, OCMS triggers the escalation to the court stage
steps.id: Setelah endorse, OCMS memicu eskalasi ke stage court
steps.why_en: Only the screen side of the trigger exists; the part that acts on it is not in the code.
steps.why_id: Hanya sisi layar dari pemicu yang ada; bagian yang menjalankannya tidak ada di code.

steps.en: The notice stage is changed to the court stage with updated dates
steps.id: Stage notice diubah ke stage court dengan tanggal yang diperbarui
steps.why_en: A general stage-change function does this, but the 2OIC endorsement does not trigger it.
steps.why_id: Fungsi ubah stage yang umum melakukannya, tetapi endorsement 2OIC tidak memicunya.

steps.en: Escalation applies to the current offender only, after eligibility checks
steps.id: Eskalasi hanya berlaku untuk offender saat ini, setelah cek kelayakan
steps.why_en: The checks belong to the general stage-change function, and the UPL offender's role cannot be confirmed.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan milik fungsi ubah stage yang umum, dan peran offender UPL belum bisa dipastikan.

steps.en: Court-stage rules such as the surcharge apply to the notice
steps.id: Aturan stage court seperti surcharge berlaku pada notice
steps.why_en: Surcharge works through the general stage-change function; whether it matches the court workflow document is unproven.
steps.why_id: Surcharge jalan lewat fungsi ubah stage yang umum; kesesuaiannya dengan dokumen court workflow belum terbukti.

steps.en: Court follow-up per the Court Processing Workflow picks up the notice
steps.id: Tindak lanjut court sesuai Court Processing Workflow mengambil notice itu
steps.why_en: No court follow-up step in the code picks up notices that are at the court stage.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada langkah tindak lanjut court di code yang mengambil notice di stage court.
